scenario.title: 在公園遇到狗主人、聊自家貓咪
scenario.context: 英文講寵物時，用 it 還是 he / she？養寵物的人幾乎都會說 he / she，用 it 可能會讓主人不太開心。這個單元也順便學反身代名詞（himself、herself），用來講寵物「自己」做的事。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Oh my gosh, your dog is so cute! Can I pet him?
lines.zh: 天啊，你的狗好可愛！我可以摸他嗎？

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Sure! Actually, she's a girl. Her name's Mochi.
lines.zh: 可以！其實她是女生，她叫麻糬。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Sorry! Hi, Mochi. How old is she?

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Three. She's a rescue. We adopted her from a shelter in Tainan.
lines.zh: 三歲，是救援犬。我們從台南的收容所領養的。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: That's amazing. Whoa, what's she doing?

lines.speaker: Owner
lines.en: Ha, she gets the zoomies every time we come here. She tires herself out in ten minutes.
lines.zh: 哈，她每次來這裡都會暴衝，十分鐘就把自己累垮。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Is that your cat on your phone background?
lines.zh: 你手機桌布是你的貓嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yes! That's Tofu. He's my fur baby.
lines.zh: 對！那是豆腐，他是我的毛小孩。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: With me, yes. With guests, he hides under the bed.
lines.zh: 對我很親，有客人來就躲在床底下。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Who takes care of him when you travel?
lines.zh: 你出去玩的時候誰照顧他？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: My neighbor feeds him. He mostly entertains himself, though. He's very independent.
lines.zh: 鄰居會餵他。不過他大多自己玩自己的，很獨立。

patterns.en: We adopted him from a shelter.
Who looks after her when you travel?
I'm more of a cat person.
patterns.note: dog person / cat person = 狗派 / 貓派

chinglish.wrong: Your dog is so cute. Can I touch it?
chinglish.right: Your dog is so cute! Can I pet him / her?
chinglish.why: 摸寵物用 pet，touch 聽起來有點奇怪。用 it 指別人的寵物也可能顯得冷淡。
「養寵物」直翻 raise 聽起來像在養殖或撫養孩子。說 I have… 就好。

chinglish.wrong: My cat plays with himself all day.
chinglish.right: My cat keeps himself busy all day. / My cat entertains himself.
chinglish.why: play with oneself 有性暗示，千萬不要用在寵物或人身上。

chinglish.wrong: My dog is very clever, it can understand people's words.
chinglish.right: My dog is so smart. He understands everything I say.
chinglish.why: people's words 是直翻，自然說法是 understand what I say。

grammar.title: 寵物用 it 還是 he/she＋反身代名詞
grammar.oneLiner: 自己或別人的寵物一般用 he / she；不確定性別或講一般動物才用 it。反身代名詞表示「自己對自己」。
whenToUse: 講有名字的寵物、有感情的對象：he / she / him / her。
不知道性別、講一般動物、牠不是誰的寵物：it。
不確定性別時可以問：Is it a he or a she? / Boy or girl?
反身代名詞：myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves。
主詞和受詞是同一個人時用：She tires herself out. / I taught myself to draw.
by oneself = 獨自：He stays home by himself.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文口語的「他」「她」「牠」「它」聽起來都一樣，寵物用「牠」也不會冒犯人。英文 it 帶有「物品」的感覺，用在別人心愛的寵物上可能顯得冷漠。另外，反身代名詞在中文裡較少出現（「他把自己累壞了」），台灣人常省略，或者用錯成 hisself / theirselves。

examples.correct: My cat is 12. She's getting old.
examples.incorrect: My cat is 12. It's getting old.
examples.note: 自己的寵物用 she / he 更自然。

examples.correct: There's a stray dog outside. It looks hungry.
examples.note: 流浪狗、性別不明，用 it 沒問題。

examples.correct: She taught herself to open the door.
They enjoyed themselves at the park.
examples.incorrect: They enjoyed theirselves at the park.

examples.correct: I can't leave my puppy home by himself yet.

quiz.question: That's my dog, Coco. ___ loves the beach.
quiz.explanation: 有名字的寵物用 she / he。

quiz.question: He hurt ___ while playing with the dog.
quiz.explanation: 主詞受詞同一人，用 himself。

quiz.question: A stranger's dog runs up to you. You don't know if it's male or female. You ask:
options: Is it a boy or a girl?
quiz.explanation: 自然地問 boy or girl。

quiz.question: I taught ___ to draw by watching YouTube.

slang.usage: 把寵物當孩子般疼愛的暱稱。

risk.note: 溫馨用語，有些人覺得有點肉麻，看對象。

examples.en: I can't travel for long. My fur baby gets lonely.
examples.zh: 我不能出遠門太久，我的毛小孩會寂寞。

examples.en: She posts photos of her fur babies every day.
examples.zh: 她每天都發毛小孩的照片。

slang.usage: get the zoomies = 貓狗突然興奮地到處狂奔。

risk.note: 可愛的用語，寵物主人都懂。

examples.en: My cat gets the zoomies at 3 a.m. every night.
examples.zh: 我的貓每天凌晨三點都會暴衝。

examples.en: After his bath, the dog had the zoomies for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 洗完澡後狗狗暴衝了十分鐘。

slang.usage: 源自網路迷因，類似「狗勾」。也有 pupper（小狗）。

risk.note: 2016–2019 年左右最紅，現在略顯過時，多用在玩笑或社群貼文。

examples.en: Look at this doggo in a raincoat!

review.explanation: 複習第 34 單元：prefer A to B。

review.explanation: 複習第 30 單元：有明確時間用過去式。

review.explanation: 複習第 22 單元：agree 是動詞。
